questions.text: SLA Depth & Enforceability: Provide comprehensive SLA documentation with analysis: Performance metrics specificity; Measurement independence; Exclusion narrowness; Financial penalty adequacy; Service credit usability.
Contract Balance & Fairness: Analyze contract symmetry: Liability limitations; Indemnification balance; Termination rights; Force majeure definitions; Change control; Dispute resolution.
questions.evidence_required: Contract terms analysis, Legal review summary

questions.text: SLA Enforcement Track Record: Provide evidence of SLA accountability: Historical breach frequency; Credit application timeliness; Vendor responsiveness; Dispute resolution outcomes; Performance improvement trends.
questions.evidence_required: SLA performance reports, Credit issuance logs

questions.text: Compliance Certifications & Audits: Submit compliance evidence portfolio: All applicable certifications; Independent audit reports; Regulatory licenses; Compliance policies; DPAs/BAAs.

Jurisdiction-Specific Compliance: Demonstrate compliance readiness for deployment jurisdiction: Regulatory requirement mapping; Compliance status per requirement; Gap remediation plans; Local entity requirements; Product certifications.
questions.evidence_required: Local compliance matrix, Gap analysis report

questions.text: Ongoing Compliance Monitoring: Describe compliance maintenance: Re-certification commitments; Regulatory change tracking; Audit rights; Breach notification protocols; Compliance reporting.
questions.evidence_required: Compliance monitoring plan, Sample compliance reports

questions.text: Dispute Resolution Structure: Detail dispute resolution framework: Multi-tier process; Accessibility; Neutrality; Speed; Enforceability.
Dispute Resolution Track Record: Provide dispute history and outcomes: Dispute frequency; Resolution effectiveness; Vendor accountability culture; Reference client experiences.
Independent Monitoring Framework: Describe performance verification systems: Monitoring independence; Real-time data access; SLA compliance tracking; Alert mechanisms; Historical data retention.

Performance Review Mechanisms: Detail accountability structures: Review frequency and participants; Review effectiveness; Scorecarding systems; Continuous improvement mechanisms; Client satisfaction measurement.
questions.evidence_required: QBR decks, Scorecard templates, CSAT results

questions.text: Change Management Governance: Assess change control maturity: Change classification; Advance notice requirements; Client approval rights; Testing protocols; Communication quality; Post-change review.

scoring_notes: Layer 3 composite formula: Weighted average of sub-dimensions.
